test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who took charge as the new vice chief of the Indian Army on 1st February 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lt Gen Manoj Pande.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Lt Gen Manoj Pande:**

__
 
• **Lt. Gen. Manoj Pande replaced Lt. Gen. C.P. Mohanty, who retired on January 31**.
 
• He replaced Lt. Gen. C.P. Mohanty as the Vice Chief of Army Staff as part of a series of changes to the Army's top leadership.
 
• He took charge** as the new vice chief of the Indian Army on 1st February 2022.**
 
• Lt. Gen. Pande had previously been the Eastern Army Commander.
 
• In December 1982, he received his commission into the Corps of Engineers (The Bombay Sappers).​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **On January 25, 2020, Lieutenant General Satinder Kumar Saini** took over as** the Indian Army's 41st Vice Chief of the Army Staff.**
 
• He was the Politician and former Vice Chief of Army Staff (VCOAS) of the Indian Army.
 
• Lieutenant General Sarath Chand is from India.
 
• From 13 January 2017 until his retirement on May 31, 2018, he held the position of Vice Chief of Army Staff.
 
• **Lieutenant General Chandi Prasad Mohanty** was the** f****ormer general officer of the Indian Army. **
 
• **On February 1, 2021, he became the 42nd Vice Chief of the Army Staff.**
